messages:
Priya: Noticed the latency panel showing p99 divergence between two deployments of the same endpoint. p50/p95 almost identical, p99 separated by ~300ms for 12m window.
Diego: Is it split by region or variant?
Priya: Split by deployment tag: blue vs green. Blue (old routing) fine, green (new routing policy) high tail.
Eloise: Can we get per-stage numbers? Our dashboard only reports total_request_ms + model_ms today.
Priya: I sampled traces: routing and outbound-proxy are the culprits, ingress and model stable.
Diego: Two engineering points: 1) instrument per-request stage map at agent so we can compute percentiles without cross-shard tdigest issues. 2) annotate the latency timeseries with rollout weights so we can see weight shifts.
Eloise: Also add a small "sample_coverage" metric for the pane. If coverage < 75% show a warning; otherwise show per-stage table.
telemetry-bot: FYI created task TELE-1091 to add per-request map to agent.telemetry.
Priya: For retries: prefer percentiles computed on summed stage durations per-request (not per-attempt). Add a flag agent.emit_attempts=false by default.
Diego: Impl note: if we can't change agent quickly, we can backfill by joining spans on request_id before quantile agg, but that is heavier and may miss sampled spans.
Eloise: UX: toggle "Stage percentiles" and an overlay "Rollout weight" that can be pinned. That will speed triage when p99 moves.
Priya: Action items: Diego to prototype internal API returning stage quantiles for visible window, Eloise to spec console toggle and badge, Priya to coordinate agent RFC. Timeline: RFC 5 days, prototype API 2 weeks.
Diego: I'll also add a counter for "tdigest_coverage" so we know how many requests contributed to each stage's sketch.
Priya: Thanks — ping this thread if you see p99 align with rollout changes.
